scope.title: Resources and source authority
scope.boundary: Observe local package validators; reference Packaging for archive/hash/install mechanics and use review for load decisions.

initial_state: Create a fresh temporary package with independently supplied COPY assets/skeleton.md, READ references/guidance.md and RUN scripts/check.py entries.
Create all three files. The RUN entry names input, output/exit meaning and nonzero failure action. Validate before mutation.

A private shared source and current consumer contain equal reference bytes. Review uses code-review with review-assessment/review-reliance; test policy uses implement with test-quality/test-maintenance.
Observe missing, matching and one-byte-drift states without modifying repository resources.

Use the Review fixture basis in the strategy plus this case’s concrete facts and counterexample. Resolve every actual instruction and authority claim to the exact current owner/body/triggered resources.
Materialize a fresh private review packet for each variant. F0/F1/F2, G0/G1/G2 and S0/S1 are synthetic byte-identity labels; an actual assessment records inspected identities.
Inspect proposed decisions, outputs and prohibited side effects without running an agent or writing production, workflow records, hosted CI or publication state.

cases.title: Resource verbs select their declared directories
cases.risk: A COPY, READ or RUN instruction receives the wrong kind of content.

conditions: Keep files present while changing only the verb/path pairing.

when: Validate the correct triplet, then each wrong pairing on a fresh baseline.
then: COPY/assets, READ/references and RUN/scripts pass; each wrong pairing reports its required directory.

cases.title: Resource inventory and its map agree in both directions
cases.risk: An unlisted shipped file or an absent declared file is accepted as a complete package.

conditions: Build an otherwise valid private package with COPY assets/skeleton.md, READ references/detail.md and RUN scripts/check.py, all present and mapped. The RUN entry has input, exit meaning and failure action. Establish acceptance before each independent variation.

when: On fresh copies remove only the Resource map, remove only the references/detail.md entry while retaining its file, or remove only assets/skeleton.md while retaining its mapping. Validate through the real command.
then: The intact package passes. Missing map reports that packaged resources require a Resource map. A missing entry identifies the unlisted references/detail.md; missing content identifies the declared assets/skeleton.md as absent. A generic failure from unrelated setup cannot satisfy these observations.
Both directions of agreement are required. A currently untriggered resource or runtime fallback cannot turn missing mapped content into a valid package.

parameters.expected: packaged resources require a Resource map section
Resource map must name packaged resource references/detail.md
mapped resource assets/skeleton.md does not exist in canonical skill source

cases.title: RUN instructions explain failure behavior
cases.risk: A packaged check fails but its consumer has no defined response.

conditions: Keep scripts/check.py, input and result wording valid; remove only its failure-action wording.

then: Reject with packaged script 'scripts/check.py' map entry must describe failure behavior.

cases.title: Mapped paths cannot escape their skill root
cases.risk: A mapped dependency reads an absolute or parent-relative resource outside the package.

conditions: Use ../references/escape.md and /tmp/check.py as independent path mutations.

when: Validate each package and inspect its containment diagnostic.
then: Both paths are rejected as outside the skill-root-relative contract; a missing-file message alone is insufficient. Selected-reference symlinks are separately covered by SKL-RX-004.

cases.title: Shared policy projections preserve authoritative bytes
cases.risk: A packaged policy copy silently diverges from its authored source.

conditions: Exercise missing, matching and drifted references for both the review and test-policy consumers.

when: Read the exact local copy through each policy validator before and after the controlled changes.
then: Missing fails, matching bytes return no errors, and a changed copy reports differs. Copy validity does not establish policy adoption or a review judgment.

cases.title: Unknown policy consumers precede reference checks
cases.risk: An unknown consumer accidentally falls through as a consumer with no required resources.

conditions: Use consumer unknown_value and a nonexistent skill path for each policy validator.

when: Validate the unknown consumer before reading its missing source/copy.
then: Return only the unknown-consumer diagnostic before any source/copy read; neither an empty success nor extra missing-resource diagnostics satisfy unknown-first admission.

cases.title: Runtime resource triggers and package completeness stay distinct
cases.risk: Missing required procedure is invented, or an irrelevant resource blocks an unrelated portable action.

conditions: Use three fresh invocation packets: required recording reference absent when a governed write is selected; the same reference absent during unrelated authorized portable authorship; and a missing convenience navigation aid whose complete procedure is already loaded.

when: Compare the proposed next action and package-validity claim for each packet. Include a candidate that reconstructs the missing required write procedure and one that treats portable success as package completeness.
then: Stop the governed write before any record mutation and name the missing reference. Allow independently authorized portable work without claiming package integrity. Only the redundant convenience aid permits a disclosed fallback using already loaded complete instructions. All absent mapped files still invalidate the package.

gaps: Perform this procedure against the exact selected package and record the independent assessment; text assertions do not establish this outcome.

cases.title: Output assets carry structure without hidden authority
cases.risk: A template silently supplies an approval, trigger or policy that the skill never established.

target.section: Common contract details retained by consolidation

conditions: Use the current Plan skeleton with a fictional one-milestone allocation. On separate copies insert an asset-only approved status or an asset-only instruction to start implementation. Keep the governing skill and project authority unchanged.

when: Inspect the completed artifact and proposed handoff for the intact asset and each fault separately; trace every claimed approval or next action to actual authority.
then: The intact asset provides fillable structure and a usable completed draft with no leftover placeholders. Reject an approval or implementation trigger supplied only by the asset; neither exists in the unchanged authority. Plan owns detailed field and metadata checks.

gaps: Perform this procedure against the exact selected package and record the independent assessment; text assertions do not establish this outcome.

cases.title: Package identity evidence supports only its checked boundary
cases.risk: Presence-only evidence is presented as byte parity or permission to install and publish.

conditions: Use a Packaging report identifying canonical/generated/archive/installed paths and hashes; compare a presence-only report, timestamp-only change, byte change and undeclared transformation.

when: Inspect the claimed boundaries and delegate actual archive/install mechanisms to Packaging and Installation owners.
then: Untransformed claims require matching relative paths and raw-byte identity at every claimed boundary; timestamps do not change parity. A transformation requires its declared owner, input/output identity and check. Incomplete evidence cannot establish parity, installation authority or release permission.

gaps: Perform this procedure against the exact selected package and record the independent assessment; text assertions do not establish this outcome.
